title: Headline €2,634 is explicitly unconfirmed per the diff's own comment, and the Q1→Q2 figure drop is unexplained in copy
detail: The acceptance gate is still open at review time: the const's own comment admits €2,634 is unconfirmed. Both posts now render side-by-side on the hub (newest-first), showing an unexplained −€194 quarterly 'fall' because the metric switched from city-centre to all-Dublin without the copy saying so.
recommended_fix: Confirm €2,634 against the Daft Q2 2026 PDF on staging before prod merge (per the comment), and add one clause in Q2's measures_paras noting the metric change from Q1's city-centre figure.

title: rent-increase-notice guide's rent-data interlink stays pinned to the now-superseded Q1 post
evidence: rent_increase_notice_view.gleam:35: "const dublin_rents_path: String = "/resources/dublin-rents-q1-2026"" and content_test.gleam:1433: "  html |> string.contains("/resources/dublin-rents-q1-2026") |> should.be_true" (rent_increase_notice_cta_and_interlinks_test).
detail: With q2 published, this hardcoded deep link and its pinning test keep steering readers from the rent-increase guide to the superseded quarter's post instead of the newest one.
recommended_fix: Derive the link from rent_post.posts (newest first) or make bumping dublin_rents_path part of the quarterly-release checklist alongside the test pin.

title: Em dash in Q2 user-facing copy where Q1's copy and three sibling pages avoid them
evidence: rent_post.gleam:122: "Nationally, asking rents rose 1.4% between March and June — a marked slowdown from the record 4.4% jump in the first quarter, …" — Q1's user-facing copy (lines 161, 185-186) contains no em dash, and content_test.gleam:727/1296/1334/1513 lock "—" out of four other content pages as a brand-voice rule ("plus the brand-voice 'no AI-powered' and 'no em dashes' rules").
detail: The rent-post page has no em-dash pin, so nothing fails, but the new copy diverges from the sibling post and the repo's per-page voice locks that treat em dashes as banned.
recommended_fix: Reword 'June — a marked slowdown' using a colon or comma to match Q1's copy and the per-page voice locks.
